scientific_rationale: This bundle is a faster low-repetition confirmation run. It preserves the full family structure and produces the same figure types as the larger rerun, but uses only 5 repetitions per condition to reduce wall-clock time. Because the sample size is much smaller, the resulting statistical evidence is intentionally weaker and should be interpreted as a quick-look bundle rather than the strongest final evidence.
